name: neighborSet_toSubgraph_startpoint

name: neighborSet_toSubgraph_internal

name: ncard_neighborSet_toSubgraph_internal_eq_two

name: exists_isCycle_snd_verts_eq
statement: G.Walk v v} (h : p.IsCycle) (hadj : p.toSubgraph.Adj v w) : ∃ (p' : G.Walk v v), p'.IsCycle ∧ p'.snd = w ∧ p'.toSubgraph.verts = p.toSubgraph.verts

name: exists_mem_support_mem_erase_mem_support_takeUntil_eq_empty
statement: Finset V) (h : {x ∈ s | x ∈ p.support}.Nonempty) : ∃ x ∈ s, ∃ hx : x ∈ p.support, {t ∈ s.erase x | t ∈ (p.takeUntil x hx).support} = ∅
